adm-bing-1.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰阿德莫尔市机场：两条跑道在草地上交叉，航站楼与机库集中在场地西南侧。
adm-bing-1.webp.en: Airborne view of Ardmore Municipal Airport — two runways crossing over green fields, the terminal and hangars clustered on the south-west side.

adm-bing-3.webp.zh: 机场入口的标识墙：石砌基座上写着「ARDMORE MUNICIPAL AIRPORT」，旁边是驻场企业的名录牌。
adm-bing-3.webp.en: The entrance sign at Ardmore Municipal Airport — the name on a stone base beside a directory of airport businesses.
